text:
Type: sofa
Name: Strathwood Grand Isle Motion Loveseat with Seat and Back Cushion
Materials: Aluminum
Cushioned loveseat with relaxing rocking motion for outdoor use; deep, wide, and roomy; seats 2 with room to spare or 3 snugly Frame made of durable yet lightweight cast aluminum with black powder-coat finish; 100-percent Olefin cushion covers 4 removable cushions have centered buttons for a tailored look; Velcro straps secure cushions to frame; no assembly; imported Each seat cushion measures 25.6 by 30.3 by 4 inches; each back cushion measures 20.5 by 25.6 by 4 inches Loveseat measures 32.5 inches high by 35.3 inches deep by 52.5 inches wide and weighs 48.5 pounds
